about: Design data for the Scarlands bestiary v1 (our own creatures, STORY_BIBLE.md §1/§3). npcType = a suggested src/game1_data.js NPC_TYPES entry (the fields shared/combat.js reads: level, hp, att, str, def, rng, mag, aBonus, sBonus, dBonus, dStab, dSlash, dCrush, dRanged, dMagic, magicAttack, maxHit, atype, ranged, attackRange, speedTicks, aggro, respawn, size); ash_stalker already exists there, so it only lists what changes. drops = a draft table in server/data/drops.json format. itemSuggestions are proposals only (no item is added by this kit). Levels follow the Wilderness depth: z1 = 48, level = floor((z - 48) / 8) + 1 in the test map.

creatures.name: Cinder rat
creatures.examine: A scorched scavenger that never travels alone. Its singed fur still smoulders.
creatures.role: weak aggressive pack creature (spawn 3-5 together, first thing north of the Ditch)

creatures.name: Scar skeleton
creatures.examine: The Scarlands burned the flesh away and left the grudge. A thrust slides between its ribs; a blow shatters it.
creatures.role: melee (sword and shield), the common undead of the ruins

creatures.name: Ash raider
creatures.examine: A northern raider who learned to shoot from behind the ruins. Heavy armour turns its arrows.
creatures.role: ranged (short bow) raider, guards the camps; keeps its distance

projectile.note: release on the clip's release frame; flight time as the server's npc ranged hit delay

creatures.name: Ember mage
creatures.examine: A robed caster who feeds on what the fire left. Arrows find it easily.
creatures.role: magic (ember bolt) caster, the ruins and the deep camps

projectile.note: a small orange fire bolt; release on the clip's release frame

creatures.name: Ash stalker
creatures.examine: It hunts where the land burned. Slag-plated hide turns aside blunt force — find the gap with a point.
creatures.role: fast melee hound (existing NPC_TYPES entry, level 38): the model for it

npcTypeChanges.note: stats unchanged; its attack is a bite (stab). Optional: speedTicks 3 if it should out-pace players, as a fast hound

creatures.name: Cinder wyrmling
creatures.examine: A young fire drake of the deep Scarlands. Its slag scales shrug off blunt blows; stay out of its breath.
creatures.role: the deep-end brute (2x2 tiles): bites and claws up close, breathes fire at range every third attack

attacks.note: needs a small NPC script (like the ash wyrm's) to alternate; blocked fully by Protect from Magic like any NPC magic

itemSuggestions.name: Stalker fang
itemSuggestions.use: crafting: an amulet string or a bone dagger (a later Crafting design)

itemSuggestions.name: Wyrmling scale
itemSuggestions.examine: A plate of cooled slag, light as bark.
itemSuggestions.use: smithing/crafting: a fire-resistant shield (a later design)
